notes: Universal Systems Inc. — operator of the Cyber Attainment Worksheet platform. Brand colors per the 2026 USI brand guidelines: Juniper #458C5E (primary), Nebula #3B697A (secondary), Desert #A68A56 (warm accent), Void #3C3C3C (text), Salt (light gray). Logo is the yin-yang S mark in the Juniper -> Nebula gradient. Tagline 'Proudly serving for 37 years' replaces the platform default.
